分龄 PBL 项目库

Age-Appropriate PBL Library

按年龄段、主题和难度提供可直接使用的城市探索项目

Ready-to-use city exploration projects organized by age, theme, and difficulty

🏛️

老街里的非遗故事

Heritage Stories in Old Streets

10-12 · 城市文化Urban Culture · 2 hrs

走进城市老街，寻找手工艺人、传统小吃和老字号，绘制一张"老街非遗地图"，向海外伙伴介绍你城市的文化根脉。

Explore old streets, find craftsmen, traditional snacks, and time-honored shops. Draw a "Heritage Map" and introduce your city's cultural roots to overseas partners.

开始项目 → Start Project →
🌳

我家门口的口袋公园

Pocket Park Near My Home

6-9 · 社区观察Community · 1.5 hrs

观察家附近的公园或绿地，记录植物、设施和人们的活动，设计一个"儿童友好型口袋公园"改造方案。

Observe nearby parks or green spaces, record plants, facilities, and activities, then design a "Child-Friendly Pocket Park" renovation plan.

一碗面的城市记忆

A Bowl of Noodles, A City's Memory

10-12 · 城市文化Urban Culture · 2 hrs

探访本地特色面馆，采访老板和食客，记录一碗面背后的城市历史与生活方式，制作一份"城市味道"纪录片脚本。

Visit local noodle shops, interview owners and customers, and document the city's history and lifestyle behind a bowl of noodles. Create a documentary script.

非遗传承人访谈计划

Heritage Keeper Interview Project

13-16 · 非遗传承Heritage · 4 hrs

联系并采访一位本地非遗传承人，记录其技艺流程、传承困境与心愿，策划一个让年轻人参与非遗保护的传播方案。

Contact and interview a local heritage keeper, document their craft, challenges, and wishes, then plan a campaign to engage youth in heritage protection.

15 分钟社区生活圈调研

15-Minute Community Life Circle

13-16 · 社区观察Community · 3 hrs

以家为中心画一个 15 分钟步行圈，调研圈内商业、医疗、教育、休闲设施的分布与缺口，向居委会提交一份改进建议。

Draw a 15-minute walking circle from home, survey commercial, medical, educational, and leisure facilities, then submit improvement suggestions to the neighborhood committee.

2050 未来城市设计

Design the City of 2050

10-16 · 未来城市Future City · 5 hrs

与海外小组伙伴共同设计一座 2050 年的理想城市，考虑气候、交通、居住、文化融合等议题，产出城市模型或数字沙盘。

Collaborate with overseas teammates to design an ideal city in 2050, considering climate, transport, housing, and cultural integration. Produce a city model or digital sandbox.

地方戏曲小传人

Young Heritage Performer

6-9 · 非遗传承Heritage · 1 hr

观看一段本地戏曲视频，学唱一句经典唱段，画一幅戏曲人物画，向外国小朋友介绍这种"会唱歌的戏剧"。

Watch a local opera video, learn a classic line, draw an opera character, and introduce this "singing drama" to foreign friends.

城市垃圾去哪儿了

Where Does City Trash Go?

10-12 · 社区观察Community · 2 hrs

追踪一袋垃圾从家门口到处理厂的全流程，采访环卫工人，绘制"城市垃圾旅行地图"，设计一个社区垃圾分类宣传方案。

Track a bag of trash from doorstep to processing plant, interview sanitation workers, draw a "Trash Travel Map," and design a community recycling campaign.

桥梁工程师挑战

Bridge Engineer Challenge

13-16 · 未来城市Future City · 4 hrs

调研本地一座桥梁的历史与结构，学习基础工程原理，用简易材料搭建桥梁模型，测试承重并优化设计。

Research a local bridge's history and structure, learn basic engineering principles, build a bridge model with simple materials, test load capacity, and optimize the design.
